description.zh: COSMIC 技术分解：把每个功能过程分解为 2-3 个子过程——数据移动（E/X/R/W）——并给出精确 CFP 计数与计划估算核对（不得低于计划值），从绿色的 cosmic-func 产物细化而来（requires topic——每话题一条需求）。
description.en: COSMIC technical breakdown: decomposes each functional process into 2-3 subprocesses — data movements (E/X/R/W) — with exact CFP counts checked against the plan estimate (never below it), refined from a green cosmic-func artifact (requires topic — one requirement per topic).

description.zh: 每功能 CFP 预算 {value, min, max}；从上游回执继承并为链重新记录
description.en: Per-function CFP budget {value, min, max}; inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

description.zh: 每功能 CFP 下限 {value, min, max}：value 约束任何单个 estimatedCfps 的下界（rule plan/cfp-func-range）；从上游回执继承并为链重新记录
description.en: Per-function CFP floor {value, min, max}: value bounds any single estimatedCfps from below (rule plan/cfp-func-range); inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

description.zh: 每功能 CFP 上限 {value, min, max}：value 约束任何单个 estimatedCfps 的上界——超过该规模的模块必须拆成多个模块功能（rule plan/cfp-func-range）；从上游回执继承并为链重新记录
description.en: Per-function CFP ceiling {value, min, max}: value bounds any single estimatedCfps from above — a module larger than this must be split into several module functions (rule plan/cfp-func-range); inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

description.zh: 由引擎派生：用 topicNoPattern 从话题名提取需求编号（显式传参可覆盖）；沿链继承；决定 <artifactPrefix>-<topicNo>-<NN> 的产物命名
description.en: Derived by the engine: requirement number extracted from the topic name via topicNoPattern (explicit values override); inherited along the chain; drives <artifactPrefix>-<topicNo>-<NN> artifact naming

description.zh: 从话题名提取需求编号的正则（首个捕获组，否则整体匹配），如话题 'KERQ-352 收藏夹' → KERQ-352
description.en: Regex (first capture group, else whole match) extracting the requirement number from the topic name, e.g. topic 'KERQ-352 收藏夹' → KERQ-352

description.zh: 总 CFP 预算 {value, downFactor, upFactor}；子过程 CFP 核对使用 desiredCfps 周围 downFactor/upFactor 的容差带（rules tech/cfp-total-vs-budget、tech/cfp-budget-advice）
description.en: Total CFP budget {value, downFactor, upFactor}; per-process CFP checks use the downFactor/upFactor tolerance band around desiredCfps (rules tech/cfp-total-vs-budget, tech/cfp-budget-advice)

description.zh: 每次数据移动的平均 CFP；沿链传递的规模基准
description.en: Average CFP per data movement; sizing guidance carried down the chain

description.zh: 目标功能在上游 plan functions 数组中的 1 起始位置；无默认值——缺失时从列出的候选中选择
description.en: 1-based position of the target function in the upstream plan functions array; no default — pick from the candidates listed when missing
